text:
```yaml
name: Build Universal macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          architecture: x64
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew install gobject-introspection gtk4 libadwaita vte4
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          
      - name: Build application
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python3 -m pip install pygobject
          python3 -m pip install pycairo
          python3 -m pip install paramiko cryptography secretstorage psutil
          
          # Build GResource
          ./build_gresource.sh
          
          # Create build directory
          mkdir -p build
          
          # Copy necessary files
          cp -r sshpilot build/
          cp -r screenshots build/
          cp -r io.github.mfat.sshpilot.desktop build/
          cp -r io.github.mfat.sshpilot.metainfo.xml build/
          cp -r sshpilot-launcher.sh build/
          cp -r run.py build/
          cp -r LICENSE build/
          cp -r README.md build/
          
          # Create app bundle structure
          mkdir -p build/sshpilot.app/Contents/{MacOS,Resources,Frameworks}
          
          # Copy executable
          cp sshpilot-launcher.sh build/sshpilot.app/Contents/MacOS/sshpilot
          chmod +x build/sshpilot.app/Contents/MacOS/sshpilot
          
          # Copy resources
          cp -r build/sshpilot/resources/* build/sshpilot.app/Contents/Resources/
          
          # Copy icons
          cp sshpilot/io.github.mfat.sshpilot.svg build/sshpilot.app/Contents/Resources/
          
          # Create Info.plist
          cat > build/sshpilot.app/Contents/Info.plist << EOF
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
          <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
          <plist version="1.0">
          <dict>
              <key>CFBundleDevelopmentRegion</key>
              <string>en</string>
              <key>CFBundleExecutable</key>
              <string>sshpilot</string>
              <key>CFBundleIconFile</key>
              <string>sshpilot.svg</string>
              <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key>
              <string>io.github.mfat.sshpilot</string>
              <key>CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion</key>
              <string>6.0</string>
              <key>CFBundleName</key>
              <string>SSHPilot</string>
              <key>CFBundlePackageType</key>
              <string>APPL</string>
              <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key>
              <string>$(python3 -c "
import re
import pathlib
content = pathlib.Path('sshpilot/__init__.py').read_text()
match = re.search(r'__version__\s*=\s*[\"'\"]([^\"'\"]*)[\"'\"]', content)
print(match.group(1) if match else '0.0.0')
")</string>
              <key>CFBundleSignature</key>
              <string>????</string>
              <key>CFBundleVersion</key>
              <string>$(python3 -c "
import re
import pathlib
content = pathlib.Path('sshpilot/__init__.py').read_text()
match = re.search(r'__version__\s*=\s*[\"'\"]([^\"'\"]*)[\"'\"]', content)
print(match.group(1) if match else '0.0.0')
")</string>
              <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key>
              <string>12.0</string>
              <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key>
              <true/>
              <key>NSPrincipalClass</key>
              <string>NSApplication</string>
          </dict>
          </plist>
          EOF

      - name: Create Universal DMG
        run: |
          # Create disk image
          hdiutil create -volname "SSHPilot" -srcfolder build/sshpilot.app -ov -format UDZO sshpilot.dmg
          
          # Verify the DMG
          hdiutil verify sshpilot.dmg
          
          # Sign the DMG if codesigning certificates are available
          if [[ -n "${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-}" ]]; then
            codesign --force --deep --sign "${CODESIGN_IDENTITY}" sshpilot.dmg
          fi

      - name: Upload DMG Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sshpilot-macos-universal
          path: sshpilot.dmg
          
      - name: Release DMG
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          files: sshpilot.dmg
          body: |
            Universal macOS DMG for SSHPilot
            
            This release includes support for both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
            
            **Release Notes:**
            - Universal binary support for ARM64 and x86_64 architectures
            - Native support for macOS 12.0+
            - All dependencies bundled within the application
```
